  - Guidelines:     As per AICTE/UGC guidelines
  - Within Timeline: Full refund minus Rs. 1,000 processing fee, prospectus fee,

  - Post Timeline (with replacement): Refund minus processing fee and

                    fills the seat
  - Post Timeline (no replacement): Only caution deposit is refundable; all
                    other academic and admission fees are forfeited

Installments:       Semester-wise payment. Contact college for hardship cases.

20.27 SCHOLARSHIP
  English: TFW (Tuition Fee Waiver) scheme is available for economically weaker
    students. BCREC also offers Swami Vivekananda Scholarship, Kanyashree for
    girls, and OASIS or Aikyashree scholarships for SC, ST, OBC, and minority
    students.

20.28 VICE PRINCIPAL
  English: The Vice Principal of BCREC is Prof. (Dr.) K. M. Hossain.

20.29 WHY BCREC
  English: BCREC, established in 2000, is NBA accredited (CSE, ECE, IT, EE, ME)
    and NAAC B+ graded. The college offers modern infrastructure, dedicated
    training cells, and a GATE Forum for career readiness.

20.30 WIFI
  English: Yes, 24-hour Wi-Fi is available across the entire campus including
    all academic blocks and hostels.
